title: T009 Implement the pure capture model in `internal/capture`. It defines `Capture`, `Kind` (`audio`|`text`), `Step` (`download → transcribe → enrich → write_note → finalize_reply → cleanup → done`,…
description:

It defines `Capture`, `Kind` (`audio`|`text`), `Step` (`download → transcribe → enrich → write_note → finalize_reply → cleanup → done`, where text captures start at `enrich`), `Status` (`pending|waiting|done`) and `Outcome` (`OK|Temporary|Misconfig|Permanent` with reason and `WaitingOn`). It also provides `Next(c, outcome, now) Capture`.

- `Next` applies the transitions from data-model.md "Steps": permanent in download/transcribe/enrich sets `failure` and jumps to `write_note`; a first entry into `waiting` flags that the reply needs a "queued" edit.
- Backoff: 5 s, doubling, ±20% jitter via an injected rand, capped by `RETRY_MAX_INTERVAL` (research R11).
